text:
emily: I just opened PR 1567 to add a tiny migration note for Console dashboard JSON templates and to fix two SDK snippets (node + python) that used the legacy tracing hook. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1567
tom: Thanks — quick scan: node snippet still uses `traceHook` camelCase, our v2 API standardized on `trace_context`. Also the dashboard JSON example references `widgets[0].metrics[0].name: \"inference_latency\"` which should be `latency_p95_ms`.
anika: Also saw a broken cross-link from /console/tracing to /console/observability that the linkcheck will flag. I can search for other occurrences.
emily: Good catches. For the Node snippet, do we prefer a backwards-compatible small shim or full replacement? We should prefer full replacement and add a short note about the old name being deprecated.
tom: I'll replace with the v2 API and add a one-line migration note: \"If you previously used traceHook, rename to trace_context and call configure_sampling(...)\". Will push in a minute.
docs-bot: linkcheck: 2 anchors failed in files docs/console/dashboards.md and docs/sdk/node/trace.md. See https://ci.redwood.ai/links/4321
anika: For dashboards, I'm going to change the example to use `latency_p50_ms` and `latency_p95_ms` and include a small paragraph on how aggregation affects cost attribution. Suggestion: add a short snippet showing how to map token counts to cost_usd in the dashboard formula field.
emily: Yes, include formula example like `cost_usd = tokens * 0.0006` and show grouping by model + route. Keep it minimal.
tom: Pushed the Node snippet fix. Also updated the fenced code block language and added a note about exporter fallback when OTLP is unavailable. Example now:
```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/sdk')
const client = new Redwood()
client.trace_context.configure({ sampling: 0.2, exporters: ['otlp'] })
client.trace_context.addTag('cost_usd', tokens => tokens * 0.0006)
```
anika: I patched dashboards.md to use the new metric names and added the formula example. I also left a short blurb about checking widget time windows (p95 needs longer window).
docs-bot: build-docs: linkcheck passed for branch docs/1567 after changes.
emily: Awesome. Can someone take the backport to release/1.2-docs? This touches Dedicated docs.
tom: I can file the backport PR after this merges.
anika: Minor follow-up: let's add a single-line note in the Python SDK guide about the `trace_context.add_metadata` helper; folks kept missing how to attach route/model tags. I'll add it in a separate small PR to avoid this one getting too big.
emily: Sounds good. I'll merge once CI completes. Thanks everyone :tada:
